brief:
Mehdi Hasan and Matthew Yglesias debated their long-standing disagreements in a studio discussion, according to Zeteo. The conversation centered on Yglesias's defense of Israel's military campaign in Gaza and his criticism of progressive Democrats, including his commentary on figures like Abdul El-Sayed.

The debate moved their dispute from social media platforms into a recorded format, addressing core policy disagreements between progressive and centrist viewpoints on Middle East conflicts and internal Democratic Party dynamics.
dek: Mehdi finally takes his long-running online feud with Yglesias off of Twitter and into the studio, challenging him on his defense of Israel’s attack on Gaza and his critiques of leftist Dems like AES.
title: Mehdi challenges Yglesias on Gaza policy and Democratic criticism
